summary_en: VitalikButerin said ZKEVMs are at alpha (production performance, safety work remaining) and PeerDAS is on mainnet, turning Ethereum into a different kind of system. 0xvimer submitted an agent authorization interface EIP. EIP-7793 conditional transactions moved to Stagnant for inactivity.
